Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649956. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join) and to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL4649956, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
